summary: Second-pass audit. I independently re-verified the high-risk evidence-validity items rather than trusting verdict_00: R1.1 SDLG write-point (phases.is_write_command correctly excludes echo/submit/stderr/fd-dups), R4.1 Chen et al. pass@k (the product form is algebraically the unbiased estimator), R5.2 entropy reader (load_entropy resolves all 10 instances from phased_decisions.log), and R2.2/R2.3 matched-k vanilla 'none' arm (diversity_method 'none' IS in VALID_DIVERSITY_METHODS and falls through to a single phased trajectory with both generators off). The ONE blocking gap left by iter 0 was R6.3 per-arm token/compute accounting, which iter 0 deferred as a 'risky run-loop instrumentation' change. That premise was wrong: the mini-swe-agent litellm model already persists the full provider response (extra.response.usage with prompt/completion/total tokens) on every assistant message, and that survives to disk in each trajectory_*.traj.json. I closed the gap by extending scripts/budget_audit.py to sum tokens per trajectory and per arm (tokens_arm_total / tokens_per_trajectory / tokens_passing_trajectories, excluding the 'primary' best-of duplicate), with a synthetic stage-level test (R8.5). On the existing results/branching artifacts this already reports ~12.9M total tokens over 53 trajectories alongside the step-fairness finding that 0 passing branches exceeded the 250-step baseline cap (max passing = 164). RESULTS.md §5 now documents the budget-audit command and the token-accounting source. All 41 tests pass; py_compile clean; every driver --help smokes. With R6.3 closed, every BLOCKER now passes on the spec's readiness bar (wiring + correctness proven; executed numbers explicitly permitted to await GPU per the DONE section). gold_standard_met is set true and blocking_gaps is empty. The headline matched-k GPU/vLLM+SWE-bench runs remain the human-only next step that turns the wired metrics into reported numbers; those are in next_actions, NOT blocking_gaps, exactly as the DONE bar allows. One honest caveat: the pre-fix results/branching artifacts have degenerate post-search entropy (1.609 = log 5, identical on all 10 instances, because they branched all 5 strategies at tau=0), so the R5.2 stratification is only exercisable on the new runs after the iter-0 tau-gate-enforcement fix.

Cost in $ omitted only because the local vLLM model is unregistered for litellm cost calc (tokens+steps are the compute proxies).
